_comment: Canonical fxc /T ps_5_0 /O3 sha1 baselines for reconstructed deferred-pipeline PSes. Captured post-Tier-1-spec-hardening. Update with verify-shader-roundtrip.ps1 --update-baselines after a deliberate refactor.

shaders.name: bsdf_light_deferred_directional
shaders.invariant: Re-baselined 2026-05-20: corrected ambient-term multiplier from posViewLen (= 1/|posView|) to roughness01 (= 1 - matSample.x). Corpus blob 3295 / runtime sha 8c615844e644 insn 251 multiplies by r0.w which is roughness01 set at insn 35. Prior baseline 085625AF (locked at 5845b9e) had the posViewLen bug; replacing the (separately-misattributed) runtime sha caused -86% scene darkening. The DIRECTIONAL bsdf must continue to round-trip to this exact sha1; any refactor that drifts it is wrong.

shaders.name: deferred_composite
shaders._baseline_history: Re-baselined 2026-05-23: applied near/far depth threshold equality fix (< -> <=) and promoted CB12 + CB2 field names + SRV role names to the RE-handoff HIGH-confidence semantics (FogState struct decode, SunDirection/SunColor, kGbufferMaterial.w material-id channel, direct-light diffuse/specular splits). Prior baselines: 06C040D0 (2026-05-20, fixed matId .y->.w, depth .y->.x, sunlit-color base secondaryColor->fogColor); 95D10F9E (original, black-screened in smoke). After this re-baseline, the post-fix corpus diff (Fallout4RE Scratch/composite-postfix-2026-05-23.md) reports -6/-6.7% instruction-count delta with EXACT match on resources, signature, declarations, and sample count. The tool also reports MISMATCH due to instruction-stream divergence after fxc reorders the emitted asm; manual review shows the flagged literals (4.0, 66.666672, 1.0) and cb references (cb12[14], [35], [44], cb2[1].w, [2].w) are all present in the HLSL at logically-matching sites and the tool's by-index alignment slipped. A future stream-alignment-aware diff (CFG reconstruction, per-node compare) is the right way to fully close the verdict; treat the current MISMATCH as structural noise, not a known semantic miss.
